gates.name: Persistent
gates.meaning: Maintains state and completes small delegated goals.

gates.name: Adaptive
gates.meaning: Learns from experience and completes persistent multi-step work.

gates.name: Self-Improving
gates.meaning: Chooses strategy, diagnoses itself, improves methods under external evaluation.

gates.name: Recursive
gates.meaning: Improves the improvement process and manages long-horizon projects.

gates.name: Discovery
gates.meaning: Discovers unknown solution methods/knowledge and validates them.

gates.name: Mission Autonomous
gates.meaning: Turns a mission into goals/projects/tasks under change.

gates.name: Open-Ended
gates.meaning: Repeatedly identifies missions and expands future intelligence.
